# ZCode UI source attribution

Source: https://github.com/zai-org/ZCode

The user-question UI reconstruction (2026-11-16) follows ElicitationDialog.tsx and its Button, Badge, Textarea and conversation layout dependencies at the same pinned commit. Vue/CSS preserves the compact rows, roving focus, bounded textarea, mobile collapse, fixed footer and explicit brand/inverse button tokens. Prism constrains the card to its existing conversation column and keeps its own question service. Source hashes and adaptations are in docs/provenance/user-questions-ui-zcode.json.

The user-question feature (2026-11-16) additionally adapts ElicitationDialog.tsx, v4/V4InteractionDialogs.tsx, lib/askUserQuestion.ts and ToolCallBlocks/renderers/ask-question.tsx, together with the AskUserQuestion tool contract/handler and docs/ask-user-question-auto-resolution.md at the pinned commit below. Prism implements its own Vue form, owner-scoped APIs, supervisor-managed deadlines and SQLite persistence. It supports optional/partial answers, custom text, single/multiple selection and a five-minute automatic continuation that permanently pauses on interaction. It does not import upstream React services, bots or remote interaction coordinators. Source hashes are retained in docs/provenance/user-questions-zcode.json.

Commit: a9fe401eede6e6e5e01be9048679c206fe6f02d9. License: Apache-2.0, retained in LICENSE.

themes.css preserves the selected Zai Light/Dark variable blocks with app selectors. Layout and Vue components adapt structures/styles from WorkspaceShellLayout, conversationLayout, ChatPromptEditor, button and dropdown-menu. Existing product behavior is retained; no React runtime or upstream services are included.

The workspace explorer and grouped conversation presentation additionally adapt interaction structures from WorkspaceFileTreeRowView, WorkspaceFileTreeRowName, WorkspaceFileTreeList, ProjectCreation, ProjectComposerMenu, ConversationTurnGroup, conversationTurnWorkSegments and ConversationWorkflowCompletion at the same commit. These are Vue adaptations for the existing broker and mock run APIs, not copied React services. See the 2026-11-11 whole-workspace delivery mapping for paths and differences.

The settings navigation, grouped setting rows and provider editor additionally adapt SettingsPage.tsx, SettingsPageParts.tsx, ModelProviderSection.tsx, ProviderCardSections.tsx and ApiKeyInput.tsx from the same pinned commit. The application implements its own Vue state, account-scoped configuration APIs and local encrypted account credential vault. No upstream credential storage, analytics or subscription services are copied.

Project and task navigation additionally adapts ProjectEditor, ProjectCreation, ProjectNodeContent, ProjectTaskRows, ProjectSidebarListHeader, useProjectTaskActions, useProjectPinIntent, projectOrder, grouped/task-context-menu-content and ArchiveManagement at the same commit. Vue state is connected to the local project's owner-scoped SQLite APIs for pinning, grouping, renaming, read state, reversible archiving and native folder selection. No remote-device, subscription or provider-log services are imported.

The full-page settings layer, project and archive management additionally adapt Root/WorkspaceSettingsLayer, settingsPageConfig, ProjectManagement, ProjectRemovalDialog, RemovedProjects, ArchiveGroupCard and useArchiveManagement. Approval controls adapt the high-permission presentation in chat-input-toolbar/display and PermissionDialog while using this project's own frozen run policy, directory grants and owner-scoped approval APIs. ChatGPT approval mode screenshots supplied by the user informed the three-mode menu; unrestricted host access is not implemented.

Conversation controls updated on 2026-11-14 additionally adapt ControlHintTooltip.tsx, components/ui/tooltip.tsx, components/ai-elements/message.tsx, v4/ConversationRowView.tsx, v4/messageTimeLabel.ts and v4/ConversationTurnNavigator.tsx at the pinned commit. Vue state, portal positioning, theme integration and API wiring are implemented locally; Radix/React services are not included. The regeneration action is a Prism extension requested by the user, not an upstream retry UI claim.

The composer add-context menu (2026-11-14) additionally adapts prompt-editor/ChatPromptActionMenu.tsx, mentions/components/MentionPanel.tsx and the file preview limit in mentions/mentionSearch.ts at the same pinned commit. Vue rendering uses existing Prism image upload and project-file reference APIs; unsupported upstream plugin/workflow/session providers and Lexical nodes are not imported.

The model metadata dialog (2026-11-14) adapts settings/model-provider-section/{ProviderModelMetadataDialog,ModelEditorAdvanced,ProviderModelModalityOptions,ProviderModelReasoningLevelEditor,ProviderModelSettingsGroups,ProviderModelDraftState,ProviderModelMetadataDialogActions}. The vision badge investigation also consulted lib/modelVisionBadge.ts. Source hashes and scope are recorded in docs/provenance/model-advanced-zcode.json. Prism uses a validated JSON request template instead of CEL, and does not enable unsupported video/PDF/native capabilities.

The sidebar view menu repair (2026-11-15) rechecks ProjectSidebarListHeader.tsx and components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx at the pinned commit. Vue adapts the portal, compact radio items, hover/focus and selected indicator. app-shell/sidePaneLayout.ts informed the resizable pane review; Prism owns the width constraints, persistence and artifact preview. The explicit top-right outputs entry follows the user-provided Codex screenshot. Source hashes are in docs/provenance/output-panel-sidebar-menu-zcode.json.

The project memory completion (2026-11-16) additionally adapts the conservative selection rules in apps/zcode-cli/packages/core/src/memory/recall/selector.ts, bounded extraction/cursor rules in extraction.ts, memory-agent-loop.ts and runtime/helpers/project-memory-extraction.ts, and index-content.ts at the pinned commit. The project service and settings viewer were reviewed from the retained local ZCode source snapshots. Prism implements its own Pi scheduling, supervised tools, conditional file writes, account-scoped Vue viewer and source-hash handoff receipts. It uses sequential safe boundaries rather than upstream parallel recall/background draining. Source hashes and adaptation scope are recorded in docs/provenance/memory-complete-zcode.json.
